name: M-CSF-driven macrophage and osteoclast development
rationale: Members cover M-CSF/CSF1 and related interleukin receptor signaling, macrophage proliferation and fusion, and osteoclast differentiation, fusion and bone resorption; the pairing of M-CSF signaling with osteoclast development separates it from confusables lacking one or the other.

name: Platelet activation by soluble-agonist receptors
rationale: All members concern platelet activation, aggregation, degranulation and coagulation, and unlike confusables centred on integrin, GP1b-IX-V or collagen adhesion the theme carries ADP P2Y, thrombin PAR, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signaling.

name: Planar cell polarity driving convergent extension
rationale: Members are PCP establishment and signaling plus convergent extension in gastrulation, axis elongation, organogenesis and neural plate shaping; convergent extension separates it from PCP/Wnt confusables and PCP separates it from axial mesoderm patterning confusables.

core: Adenylate cyclase inhibition by Gi/Gz-coupled receptors
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic inhibition of adenylate cyclase
rationale: Members describe G-protein control of adenylate cyclase and cAMP, dominated by Gi/Gz inhibitory signaling from alpha-2 adrenergic receptors, distinguishing it from muscarinic/purinergic Gi confusables and cAMP-PKA activation confusables.

core: NK and T cell cytotoxicity regulation
name: NK cell cytotoxicity regulation via MHC class Ib receptors
rationale: Members regulate NK and T cell cytotoxicity, NK activation, degranulation and NK signatures, and add MHC class Ib presentation and lymphoid/non-lymphoid receptor interactions that the KIR- and granzyme-centred confusables lack.

name: Embryonic craniofacial morphogenesis with limb patterning
rationale: Members are embryonic head, face, palate, nose, cranium and limb/digit morphogenesis from mesenchyme; the limb and palate members separate it from confusables built around pharyngeal-derived organs or ossification.

qualifier: via focal adhesion and fibronectin matrix assembly
name: Fibroblast focal adhesion and matrix assembly
rationale: Members concern integrin and fibronectin matrix formation, focal adhesion assembly, SRF-linked cytoskeletal remodeling and fibroblast migration, distinguished from integrin/syndecan interaction confusables and from EMT/stromal confusables.

name: Skeletal muscle growth restraint and disuse atrophy
rationale: Members negatively regulate myoblast and myotube differentiation and muscle development, maintain satellite cells, and cover atrophy and inactivity responses, unlike confusables centred on promoting myogenesis, hypertrophy or contraction.

name: Recombination-based telomere maintenance via break-induced replication
rationale: Members cover telomere recombination, t-circles, D-loop disassembly, break-induced replication, recombination intermediate resolution and replication-associated telomere maintenance, with BIR and intra-S checkpoint members absent from the confusables.

name: PKA activation by GPCR-driven cAMP synthesis
rationale: All members concern stimulatory GPCR-cAMP signaling: cAMP synthesis, forskolin response and PKA activation; the GPCR-coupled cAMP synthesis members separate it from CREB/neuronal adenylate cyclase confusables, and stimulation separates it from inhibitory cyclase confusables.

name: COPI-mediated vesicle targeting between Golgi and ER
rationale: Members are vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi plus COPI budding and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic, distinguishing it from COPII anterograde and ER protein-targeting confusables.

name: Kidney development through metanephric nephron patterning
rationale: All members concern nephric duct, ureteric bud and nephron development, with metanephric nephron tubule segmentation and patterning members that confusables centred on ureteric bud induction lack.

core: Membrane traffic to the plasma membrane
name: Membrane traffic to plasma membrane via endosomal recycling
rationale: Members cover endocytic and receptor recycling, endosome-to-plasma membrane and Golgi-to-plasma membrane transport and vesicular cholesterol traffic, distinguishing it from endosome-to-Golgi retrograde and tubulation confusables.

name: Myeloid progenitor transcription restraining terminal differentiation
rationale: Members cover transcriptional programmes of myeloid progenitors (RUNX1, VENTX, granulopoiesis, promyelocytes) with progenitor proliferation and negative regulation of granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation, unlike confusables that promote differentiation or monocyte trafficking.

qualifier: oncogenic activation with ERK feedback shutoff
name: Oncogenic RAF-MEK-ERK activation with ERK feedback shutoff
rationale: Members span RAF activation, RAS/RAF/MAP2K/MAPK mutant signaling and ERK negative feedback and dephosphorylation; the mutant RAF members distinguish it from RAS-GAP confusables and the feedback members from SOS/Ras-activation confusables.

name: Vitamin K and ascorbate metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation together with ascorbate metabolism and transport and responses to vitamins C, E and K; this K-plus-C combination separates it from vitamin E/D/quinone and oxygen-transport confusables.

core: Dendritic cell chemokine and cytokine production
name: cGAS-STING-driven dendritic cell chemokine production
rationale: Members regulate CCL5 and dendritic cell cytokine production and STAT6 chemokine induction plus cGAMP import and cGAS-STING activation, which the chemokine and Th1 confusables lack, while the TLR7/9 and STING-restraint confusables lack the chemokine members.

name: Non-coding RNA methylation and snRNP biogenesis
rationale: Members cover rRNA, tRNA and snRNA methylation and processing, snoRNP and snRNP assembly, cap hypermethylation and Cajal body RNA localization; the snRNP assembly and cap hypermethylation members are absent from the pseudouridylation and ribosome-assembly confusables.

core: Cytoplasmic mRNA stability and translation control
name: Stress-granule control of mRNA stability and translation
rationale: Members regulate mRNA stabilization and decay by RNA-binding proteins and translational silencing alongside stress granule assembly, PKR and arsenite stress; stress granule and translation-initiation members distinguish it from mRNA-decay confusables.

name: Chondrogenesis in embryonic cartilage and joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members regulate chondrocyte differentiation, proliferation, hypertrophy and cartilage condensation and morphogenesis, with joint morphogenesis members absent from ossification- and articular-cartilage confusables.

name: KATP channel-coupled insulin secretion by beta cells
rationale: Members concern insulin processing and secretion regulated by glucose, incretins, fatty acids and neurotransmitters in beta cells, and the KATP channel and ABCC8/9 members distinguish it from insulin-signaling and GLUT4 confusables.

name: Ubiquitin-proteasome turnover with linkage-specific deubiquitination
rationale: Members span E1/E2/E3 ubiquitination, linkage-specific chain synthesis and removal, DUB families, proteasome assembly and degron pathways; DUB and proteasome members distinguish it from neddylation and autophagy/ERAD confusables.

name: Rab-regulated Golgi organization and COPI vesicle traffic
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon assembly and disassembly, COPI ER-Golgi and intra-Golgi traffic, vesicle tethering, and Rab/ARF regulation including geranylgeranylation, distinguishing it from TGN-lysosome and endosome-Golgi confusables.

name: Proline and glutamine-family amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid metabolic terms with proline biosynthesis and catabolism and glutamine-family metabolism as the specific content, unlike glycine/serine and organic acid confusables.

name: Non-visual retinoid metabolism and retinoic acid synthesis
rationale: Members cover retinol, retinal and retinoic acid metabolism and transport including STRA6 uptake defects, distinguished from the visual retinoid cycle confusable and from retinoid response and vitamin D confusables.

name: Telomere end protection restraining recombination and telomerase
rationale: Members concern telomere capping, packaging, NHEJ protection, inhibition of telomeric recombination and negative regulation of telomerase, unlike confusables centred on telomere replication or telomerase extension.

name: High-energy phosphate and NAD(P) cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover NAD/NADP synthesis, salvage and transport, nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion, mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport and creatine/phosphocreatine; the NAD and creatine members respectively separate it from confusables lacking them.

name: Telomere maintenance including telomerase Cajal-body trafficking
rationale: Members span telomerase extension, recombination, C-strand synthesis, capping and protection; scaRNA and telomerase RNA localization to Cajal bodies distinguish it from the broad DNA repair confusables.

name: TLR- and NLRP3-driven inflammatory cytokine regulation
rationale: Members regulate TLR2/3/4 signaling, LPS and lipopeptide detection, NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasomes and IL-1, IL-6 and TNF production; inflammasome members separate it from TLR-only confusables and TLR ligand sensing from the pyroptosis confusable.

name: Beta-catenin signaling controlled by AXIN stability
rationale: Members cover beta-catenin/TCF target activation and destruction-complex control via AXIN degradation, stabilization and AXIN1/APC mutants, distinguished from confusables centred on receptor-level Wnt regulation or target repression.
